arguments.summary: Fixed issue #34 in lru/cache.py: `get()` returned the value on a hit without updating recency, so reads didn't count as use and the just-read key could be evicted. The fix re-inserts the key on a hit (delete then set) to move it to the most-recently-used position in the backing dict. Verified with t...
